scrape_notes: Manufacturer direct, HealthWarehouse, Sesame, telehealth, and ZIP 10001 SingleCare consulted; many monitored online outlets did not expose dose-specific cash prices.
GoodRx product pages and browser did not expose usable named pharmacy injection quotes; SingleCare 5mg Mounjaro, 0.25/0.5mg Ozempic, and 2.4mg Wegovy are one-month quotes only.
The Lilly pricinginfo page displayed no numeric WAC; LillyDirect verified self-pay $499 for all six strengths. WAC is not treated as retail cash price.
No prices from October 1 were carried into October 2. Null denotes not confirmed today.
Oral pills, compounded versions, Zepbound, insurance copays, and unrelated monthly membership fees excluded from prices.
Calibrate.com is parked and FoundNow.com is a travel site; both excluded. Rite Aid page says pharmacy services coming soon.
